text: Jeffrey Cantos, Manager, Strategic Initiatives, Policy and Analysis (SIPA), Infrastructure and Development Services, City Planning will provide an update on the Municipal Comprehensive Review (MCR) under way, its consultations with the film industry and other sectors, the path the MCR is taking, as well as provide a briefing on South of Eastern Employment Lands and the impact of potential changes in the zoning of key sites in the area.
The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board received the item for information.
